soundness_flags.label: ass:price-curvature
soundness_flags.one_line: For the generally non-symmetric Jacobian J_eta, lambda_min is undefined as written; specify a symmetric profiled Hessian or use a smallest-singular-value/invertibility condition and state differentiability of the profiled map.

soundness_flags.label: lem:deterministic-band-inversion
soundness_flags.one_line: Once g_P is nonincreasing and lies between the bands, kappa_b=T_b[g_P] belongs to C_b by the definition of C_b, so the lemma is a pure definitional containment rather than a theorem-level contribution.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: oeq:root-stability-bias; thm:uniform-endpoint-process; thm:full-ray-breakdown
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Uniform conditional-root stability and the quadratic held-out bias bound are open and are not assumed established.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The Gaussian endpoint band and full-ray coverage claims are accepted only conditional on a positive resolution of oeq:root-stability-bias; population sharpness and duality are separate theorem obligations.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article introduces a one-treatment second-moment propensity-ratio sensitivity model, sharp bounds, efficient one-step estimators, and multiplier-bootstrap simultaneous sensitivity-curve bands.

The paper considers propensity-, outcome-, and subset-confounding sensitivity models and extends its methods to time-varying treatments.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the price-curvature condition by an explicitly defined symmetric profiled Hessian with a uniform positive-definiteness bound, or by a uniformly positive smallest singular value plus differentiability; then state which version is used in the root-stability route.
Demote deterministic band inversion to a definition/corollary and make the inferential contribution the nontrivial sequential process construction plus its face-extension guarantee.
Add one fully specified finite-support interior law that computes both positive prices, exhibits dependence on each budget, and contrasts the resulting interval with both named comparator classes.

recommended_next_step: Revise the Jacobian regularity condition and remove the definitional inversion lemma as a theorem-level result, then advance the population sharpness/dual kernel and retain inference explicitly conditional on the root-stability OEQ.
